items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Morton Gould used to call me and say, “I’m recording next week I need Doc, I need Bobby — fix Tuesday and Wednesday so I can have them.”

ctx.x: Yeah. It gave them visage they had never had, and that visual thing brought them to every conductor. Morton Gould used to call me and say, “I’m recording next week I need Doc, I need Bobby — fix Tuesday and Wednesday so I can have them.”
